crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

translations.web: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
translations.bsb: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
translations.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
translations.asv: Hear, my sons, the instruction of a father, And attend to know understanding:
